data.name: Bigscreen Beta
data.detailed_description:
Bigscreen enables people to watch videos in VR with friends through a variety of ways! Share your desktop screen, watch high quality, premium 3D movies, attend live rocket launch events, play your own video files using our new videoplayer feature, and much more!

Watch your favorite movies with friends and family around the world in a cozy home theater or a massive IMAX-style cinema! Relive the good ol' days when you hung out with friends IRL and played video games in the basement until 4AM. Screen cheat or strategize and play together! Instead of that tiny 13" laptop, play any game on massive, customizable screens. Wrap the virtual screen around you for a more immersive experience.



See your PC's desktop screen on huge virtual monitors! There's multi-monitor support for up to three virtual monitors and all customizable to any shape or size. With desktop screensharing and multi-monitor capabilities, you can also work alongside the videoplayer, enabling you to put the videoplayer on the big screen, while being
surrounded by monitors. This enables a mix of productivity and entertainment, creating the ultimate workspace.


Bigscreen's partnership with movie studios, such as Paramount Pictures, provides official movie broadcasts and enables you to rent and watch high quality 3D movies in VR. You can also watch movies in side-by-side 3D or over-under 3D directly from your desktop. Our videoplayer supports many file formats and codecs, including 3D movies!


Worried about not having the same VR headset? There's cross-platform VR headset support for the Oculus Rift, Oculus Rift S, Oculus Quest, HTC Vive, any SteamVR headset, and any Windows Mixed Reality headset!


Want to socialize a bit? Create or join public or private rooms for up to 12 people! Check out what other people are doing in their rooms, hang out, and make new friends!


Find a scene that fits your mood! Choose from a variety of environments such as an actual movie theater, a retro-styled theater, a space station, campfires, modern living rooms, and more!


Maybe you're not always here to watch a video or a movie. 3D markers are available for you to create images in the virtual space, and you can share that with anyone that hangs out in your room. They might even want to draw beside you!





We're always working on new features! Feel free to let us know how we can improve your experience in Bigscreen from the options listed in the Support section below.

  • FRIEND SYSTEM: Add your friends to your list so they can easily join your rooms.
  • NEW AVATARS: Updated avatar options will be available for you to customize even further.
  • Built-in YouTube and TV channels in your own rooms.
  • More movie studio partnerships to host even more 3D movie screenings!


Experiencing a bug? Crashing? Need help? Join our community from one or all of the options below, and we'll be happy to help! Our community is very supportive and sometimes reply quicker than us:

  • Directly email us at support@bigscreenvr.com.
  • Join the for the speediest replies!
  • Post on our Steam forums since this is on Steam.

data.short_description: Bigscreen lets you use your PC desktop in VR. Watch movies with friends in a virtual movie theater. Play your favorite PC video games on a huge screen. Hangout in social VR chat rooms. Participate in weekly 3D Movie Nights, VR LAN parties, live rocket launch events, and more!

reviews.review:
[h1]Disappointed - and it affects how I see the company[/h1]

I wanted to like Bigscreen Beta. The idea is great, and on Windows it clearly worked well for a lot of people. But my experience as a Linux user, and the way the developers have handled it over the years, leaves me unable to recommend it.

[h2]The situation on Linux[/h2]
[list]
[*]There is no native Linux version, so it has to run through Proton.
[*]The desktop view - one of the core features - only shows a black screen.
[*]Joining a room from the social menu crashes the app.
[/list]
I'm not expecting a free program to support every platform. But Linux users have been asking about this since at least 2019, and the community has documented these issues on ProtonDB and here in the forums for years.

[h2]Years of "maybe later"[/h2]
In October 2020, a developer wrote here on Steam that Linux support was something they hoped to do in the future, after a Mac port and a PSVR port. That was six years ago. Since then I haven't seen any update, roadmap, or even a clear "we're not doing it". Users in the forums also ask whether the Steam version has been left behind compared to the Meta version.

A clear "no" would honestly have been better than leaving people hoping indefinitely.

[h2]Why this matters to me beyond the app[/h2]
Bigscreen now also sells hardware - the Beyond headsets. For a VR headset, long-term software support is everything. When a company lets its flagship software drift and doesn't communicate clearly with its users, I find it hard to trust that its hardware will be supported any better years down the line.

For that reason, I won't be buying a Bigscreen headset.

[h2]Summary[/h2]
[b]+[/b] Good concept, works for many on Windows
[b]–[/b] Desktop view and social features broken on Linux/Proton
[b]–[/b] Linux support "hoped for" since 2020, no follow-up
[b]–[/b] Little communication with the Steam/PC community

If the developers ever give a clear answer on Linux, or fix the Proton issues, I'll gladly update this review.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Requer um sistema operativo e processador de 64 bits
  • Sistema Operativo: Windows 10
  • Processador: Intel i5-4590
  • Memória: 8 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD 290 equivalent or greater
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 1500 MB de espaço livre
  • Compatibilidade com R.V.: SteamVR or Oculus PC
